As our Mechanical Engineering Technician you will conduct tests of mechanical systems, collect and analyse data, and assemble and install mechanical assemblies in support of Mechanical Engineers and Engineering Technologists.

Main Tasks:

Selects tools and equipment
Assembles and installs new and modified mechanical assemblies, components, machine tools and controls, and hydraulic power systems
Estimates material costs and quantities, and machine requirements
Performs and directs field and laboratory tests
Collects and analyses data, carries out complex computations and prepares diagrams
Organises and supervises inspection and maintenance of machines and plant
Ensures that designs and finished work are within specifications, regulations and contract provisions
Key Skills:

Problem solving

Creativity

Manufacturing

Teamwork

Attention to detail

Collaboration

Computer literacy

Data analysis

Interpersonal skills

Mechanical systems

Technical writing

Computer-aided design

Time management

Communication

Analysis skills

Math skills

An ability to communicate well with others

Minimum 1 year experience in a similar role 

Full time

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $87,500.00 – $107,500.00 per year + Superannuation
